title: 三位联储主席：罕见同时反对，内部分歧藏不住了
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This week we'll get a detailed look into the thinking of the Federal Reserve when it comes to its latest interest rate decision minutes from last month's FOMC meeting
segments.zh: 本周我们将深入了解美联储对最新利率决策的思考，即上月FOMC会议纪要。

segments.en: We'll be released Carol on Wednesday. Yeah, a lot of questions coming off of the press The press conference is right with the Fed chair. Hey last month's decision
segments.zh: 卡罗尔周三将公布。是的，在新闻发布会后有很多问题，与美联储主席有关。

segments.en: Not to raise rates saw a rare descent from three regional bank presidents We're joining us right now to make some sense out of it all is Jennifer Lee. She's senior economist at BMO capital markets
segments.zh: 上次会议决定不加息，但三位地区联储主席罕见反对。我们请来BMO资本市场高级经济学家詹妮弗·李解读。

segments.en: Jennifer good to have you here with us This is a focal point in this new era of the US central bank
segments.zh: 詹妮弗，欢迎你。这是美国央行新时代的一个焦点。

segments.en: What are you watching out for when it comes to the FOMC minutes?
segments.zh: 对于FOMC会议纪要，你关注什么？

segments.en: Well good morning and thanks for having me on you know, it'll be very interesting to see how much of eight I'm going to use my air quotes here by the good family fight
segments.zh: 早上好，谢谢邀请。看看有多少“家庭内部争论”会很有趣，我用了引号。

segments.en: Really took place behind this scene. I would love to be a fly on the ball on that front And this will be the interesting one because you know, this is like the second meeting that that Fed chair was chaired over
segments.zh: 这真的发生在幕后。我很想成为墙上的苍蝇。这次会很有趣，因为这是美联储主席主持的第二次会议。

segments.en: The first one everyone was unanimously behind him supporting on the decision to stay the course And then the second one boom three dissenters so be very interesting to see what kind of discussion went on behind the scenes
segments.zh: 第一次会议大家一致支持他的决定，保持原样。第二次会议，砰，三位反对者。所以看看幕后进行了什么样的讨论会很有趣。

segments.en: And then of course how much of it will heat up in the coming months as well as well just given all the mixed data that we've seen of late We've seen a big move in interest rates and there was quite the freak out in the markets following
segments.zh: 然后，考虑到最近混合的数据，未来几个月会有多少升温。我们看到利率大幅波动，市场在最近会议后出现了恐慌。

segments.en: The most recent meeting that we'll be reading into in these minutes Jennifer when's the 10 year going to hit 5%
segments.zh: 我们将在这些会议纪要中读到这些。詹妮弗，十年期收益率什么时候会达到5%？

segments.en: Oh, that's a great question. I wouldn't be surprised if it's you know sooner rather than later just given the upward pressure
segments.zh: 这个问题问得好。考虑到上行压力，我觉得可能很快就会发生。
